pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Kaṇḍakassa nāma samaṇuddesassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.4: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū: Kaṇḍakassa nāma kira samaṇuddesassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.6: bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo, read Kaṇḍako samaṇuddeso; instead of
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.27: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.31: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Kaṇḍakaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ nāsetu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.33: ajjatagge te āvuso Kaṇḍaka na c' eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.34: yaṃ pi c' aññe samaṇuddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dvirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ sāpi te n' atthi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.36: atha kho saṃgho Kaṇḍakaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ nāsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.37: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ tathā nāsitaṃ Kaṇḍakaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpenti pi upaṭṭhāpenti pi saṃbhuñjanti pi sahāpi seyyaṃ kappenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.39: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ tathā nāsitaṃ Kaṇḍakaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpessanti pi upaṭṭhāpessanti pi saṃbhuñjissanti pi sahāpi seyyaṃ kappessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.40: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ tathā nāsitaṃ Kaṇḍakaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpethāpi upaṭṭhāpethāpi saṃbhuñjathāpi sahāpi seyyaṃ kappethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.43: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ . . . kappessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.44: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.45: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.47: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.48: so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.49: māvuso samaṇuddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.50: anekapariyāyena āvuso samaṇuddesa antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.51: evañ ca pana so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva paggaṇheyya, so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.52: ajjatagge te āvuso samaṇuddesa na c' eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.53: yaṃ pi c' aññe samaṇuddesā labhanti bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ dvirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ, sāpi te n' atthi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:1.55: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathā nāsitaṃ samaṇuddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā upaṭṭhāpeyya vā saṃbhuñjeyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.8: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti, tehi vattabbo: mā āvuso samaṇuddesa evaṃ avaca . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.12: sace paṭinissajjati, icc etaṃ kusalaṃ. no ce paṭinissajjati, so samaṇuddeso bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.21: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.27: tassa pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā uddesaṃ vā paripucchaṃ vā dassāmīti upalāpeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.29: tassa cuṇṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā dantakaṭṭhaṃ vā mukhodakaṃ vā sādiyati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.39: ekacchanne nāsitake samaṇuddese nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.1.40: bhikkhu nipanne nāsitako samaṇuddeso nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc70:2.2.1: nāsitake nāsitakasaññī upalāpeti vā upaṭṭhāpeti vā saṃbhuñjati vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
